name: On My Desk Still
description: A top-down phone photo of the product on a lived-in creator desk, warm lamp light. Reads as a real desk, not a set.
prompt: {{product}} on a cluttered creator desk beside a laptop, coffee mug and notebook, top-down phone photo, warm lamp light, {{extra}}, no text
negative_prompt: studio backdrop, text, watermark, duplicated product

slots.name: product
slots.label: Product
slots.help: A product Element; it is injected as its @handle.

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.help: e.g. 'a pair of headphones just out of frame'
